title: Film shot cards (version 1): the animated shots of an approved script, from which every picture, video and sound prompt is composed (docs/SHOT_PROMPTS.md, KP-15..KP-34)

facing.description: camera, left, right, away, or a cast id this person looks at

pose.description: the visible pose in the shot's FIRST frame (the start of the action)

on.description: what the person stands, sits or lies on, as a phrase: 'standing on the packed snow', 'sitting on the bus step' (KP-31)

height.description: how much of the frame height the figure fills (KP-32)

height_pct.description: the same as a number, for the words-vs-numbers test; wins over height in the prompt when set

script.description: the approved production script these shots film (path next to this file)

trigger.description: the style LoRA's trigger, first words of every keyframe prompt

video_sentence.description: ONE fixed style sentence, first in every video prompt (KP-10)

name.description: the story name; never written into a prompt (KP-22)

tag.description: the one visible identity tag, the same words in every prompt (KP-15)

voice.description: how the voice sounds, for the video model's dialogue (never a person's name)

scene.description: the script segment (S01..) this shot belongs to

line.description: index of the script line it plays, when it plays one

mode.description: scene = sync dialogue or acting in the drama; narrated = the narrator speaks over it, nobody in frame speaks; establish = place and time; insert = a prop or a detail, no face

beat.description: what this shot does for the story, one sentence (KP-28)

camera_end.description: how the frame looks after the move (LTX completes a move it can see the end of)

over.description: OTS: the cast id whose shoulder is in the foreground

crosses_line.description: true only when the shot means to cross the 180-degree line

relations.description: unambiguous relations between things in the picture, one sentence each: 'a living woolly mammoth stands behind the boulder' (KP-33)

lead_room.description: the free space the action moves into (KP-34); side none = the action stays in place

for.description: what the space is for: 'where he will fall'

start.description: the anticipation: what the first frame shows

peak.description: the big move, with body parts

settle.description: the end pose the shot holds (and the last frame, if guided)

face.description: the emotion as the lens sees it: eyes, brows, mouth, shoulders

to.description: a cast id present, or room / self

delivery.description: how it is said: pace, loudness, colour (from the performance-director)

narration.description: the narrator's words over this shot (mode narrated); never what the picture already shows

loudest.description: the one loud sound, said once

diegetic_music.description: music with a visible source in the shot (a radio, a band); score music belongs to the edit

source.description: how the first frame is drawn: a new keyframe, a next pose of the scene's master, or a cut (new size or angle) of the same scene

master.description: nextpose / cut: the shot id whose keyframe is the scene's master

last_frame.description: true: the settle pose is drawn too (a next pose of the master) and guides the clip's last frame
